scope: Source-level multi-tenant isolation controls implemented in enterprise/tenancy.py and exercised by tests/multitenancy.

evidence.organisationScopedIdentities: assert_organisation_id refuses absent, empty, and wildcard tenant scopes; every identifier must match org-<slug>.
evidence.organisationScopedStorage: scoped_filter always injects the tenant predicate and refuses a caller filter that tries to override it; filter_rows refuses rows with no organisationId rather than treating them as unscoped.
evidence.organisationScopedEncryptionKeys: Fleet-control signing keys use the reserved fleet- namespace, separate from OS update, release, OEM, and sync namespaces; sync collection keys never leave the device.
evidence.strictApiAuthorisation: assert_same_tenant is a required call for all 11 tenant-scoped resource families and refuses on mismatch.
evidence.auditIsolation: verify_chain is per-organisation; an entry belonging to another organisation breaks verification, and append_entry refuses to extend a chain with a foreign organisation's entry.
evidence.rateLimits: Declared as a control the hosted service must implement; no hosted service exists yet, so this is a design commitment recorded here and not a measured property.
evidence.exportBoundaries: audit.retention_policy declares one organisation per export and no multi-organisation export.
evidence.backupIsolation: assert_same_tenant covers the backup resource family, so restoring a backup into another tenant is refused.

limitations: These are source-level controls verified by host tests. No multi-tenant service has been deployed, load-tested, or penetration-tested.
rateLimits and exportBoundaries are partly commitments about a service that does not exist; they are recorded as true for the source contract only.
No independent security assessment of a running control plane has been performed.
adversarialTests: organisation A reading organisation B devices
